scenarios.title: A retrace card can be cast from the graveyard only by discarding a land card
decisions: A has priority in main phase 1 with an empty stack and considers casting Flame Jab from the graveyard via retrace, paying {R} with the battlefield Mountain and discarding the Mountain in hand as the additional cost.

variants.label: land_in_hand
variants.expected: Casting Flame Jab from A's graveyard is legal (can_play true).

variants.label: no_land_in_hand
variants.delta: A's hand holds Grizzly Bears instead of Mountain.
variants.expected: A has no land card to discard, so casting Flame Jab from the graveyard is not legal (can_play false).

variants.label: mana_unavailable
variants.delta: The Mountain on A's battlefield is tapped.
variants.expected: A cannot pay {R}, so casting Flame Jab from the graveyard is not legal (can_play false), although a land card is in hand.
